name: Enshrouded: Thralls of Twilight
summary: Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements!
